51570228.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to RXR alpha LBD (unknown origin) assessed as dissociation constant at 25 degree C by isothermal titration calorimetry assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - Isothermal Titra: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) experiments were conducted on an Affinity ITC instrument (TA Instruments, New Castle, DE) at 25 °C with a stirring speed of 75 rpm. RXRα LBD protein (8 μM, prepared as described previously24,50) in buffer (20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 100 mM NaCl, 5% glycerol) containing 4% DMSO was titrated with rac-27 (40 μM) in the same buffer containing 4% DMSO in 26 injections (1 × 1 and 25 × 4 μL) with an injection interval of 150 s. As control experiments, rac-27 was titrated into the buffer and the buffer was titrated into the RXRα LBD protein under otherwise identical conditions. The heat of the compound-RXRα LBD titration was analyzed using NanoAnalyze software (TA Instruments) with an independent binding model.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption - ITC data: Figure 2. Profiling of rac-27. (a) rac-27 activated full-length human RXR on the RXR:RXR homodimer and the RXR:RAR heterodimer response elements with low nanomolar potency. Data are the mean ± S.E.M. fold activation; n = 4. (b) rac-27 induced mRNA expression of the RXR homodimer-regulated glycerophosphodiester phosphodiesterase 1 (GDE1) in HT29 cells. Data are the mean ± S.E.M. relative GDE1 mRNA expression with GAPDH as a reference gene; n = 6; ***p < 0.001, ****p < 0.0001 (ANOVA). (c) High-affinity binding of rac-27 to the RXRα LBD was confirmed by isothermal titration calorimetry. The isotherm at 25 °C is shown. (d) rac-27 exhibited no off-target activity in the nuclear receptor family at 1 μM corresponding to >100-fold selectivity. rac-27 was tested alone and in competition with the selective reference ligands (see Experimental section). Data are the mean ± S.E.M.; n = 3. (e) rac-27 was nontoxic up to 30 μM concentration in COS-7 cells. Data are the mean ± S.E.M.; n = 3. Doxorubicin (100 μM) as a positive control. (f) rac-27 exhibited high microsomal stability. Propranolol for comparison. Data are the mean ± S.E.M.; n = 6 (rac-27), n = 3 (propranolol).
